title: Bajo volumen, alta intensidad
author: David Gonzalo Hernandez Alcaraz
desc: Unleash your strength with "Bajo volumen, alta intensidad," a focused 1-week bodybuilding program designed for those ready to push their limits. Comprising three intense 90-minute sessions, this plan emphasizes high-intensity lifts that target major muscle groups, including the chest, back, and legs. With a mix of compound and isolation exercises, you'll build muscle while honing your technique in a garage gym setting. Perfect for intermediate lifters looking to elevate their training and achieve impressive gains!
